axis_definitions.COMPETITIVE: Explicit win/title/record versus explicit loss/qualification failure.
axis_definitions.PROJECT: Commercial/critical/project success versus explicit project failure/cancellation.
axis_definitions.STATUS: Explicit role/electoral/leadership gain versus explicit role/electoral/leadership loss.

seed_universe_amendment.reason: Wave 2 uses a newly predeclared role-only candidate universe rather than reusing the Wave 1 base list. It was expanded before any Wave 2 event collection or astrology scoring to provide enough fresh eligible subjects after prior-development and Wave-1 exclusions. Identity checking (name/birth identity only) is permitted; event outcomes and chronology are forbidden.
permitted_information_used_for_expansion: broad public career/role category needed to preassign one of COMPETITIVE/PROJECT/STATUS
membership in previously consumed development corpora
forbidden_information_not_used: whether a subject is easy or hard to pair

post_freeze_rules.pair_rule: Within each frozen subject's preassigned axis, select the source-verified opposite-polarity pair with minimum absolute year gap among retained candidates; distinct years required.
post_freeze_rules.if_combined_targets_not_met_after_wave2: Freeze Wave 2 and create another fresh wave using only remaining axis deficits and observed pairability; never directional chronology backfill.
post_freeze_rules.if_combined_targets_met_after_wave2: Run combined event-corpus freeze/QA first; only then permit astrology feature generation.
